invariant_groups.name: substance-preserving-compression
invariant_groups.description: Remove filler while retaining technical substance.

invariant_groups.name: exact-preservation
invariant_groups.description: Preserve polarity, limits, numbers, units, code, identifiers, APIs, commands, and quoted errors.

invariant_groups.name: no-caricature
invariant_groups.description: Compression must not add fake grammar, prefixes, invented abbreviations, or causal arrows.
markers: Never announce or name this mode

invariant_groups.name: language-and-grammar
invariant_groups.description: Keep the user's language and grammatical role markers; reserve classical Chinese for wenyan modes.

invariant_groups.name: safety-clarity
invariant_groups.description: Use normal clarity for destructive, security, legal/medical, ambiguity, data-loss, and ordered-recovery cases.

invariant_groups.name: artifact-boundary
invariant_groups.description: Persisted and external human-facing artifacts remain normal prose unless explicitly requested otherwise.

invariant_groups.name: mode-boundaries
invariant_groups.description: Preserve intensity grammar, persistence, activation, deactivation, and explicit mode boundaries.

warning: Verify a backup exists before proceeding
intensity_rows: | **lite** | Remove filler and hedging. Keep articles and tight full sentences |
| **full** | Drop articles; fragments and short synonyms OK. Classic caveman |
| **ultra** | Strip unneeded conjunctions. State each fact once. One word when enough |
| **wenyan-lite** | Semi-classical register with grammar structure retained |
| **wenyan-full** | Fully 文言文; classical patterns, omitted subjects, classical particles |
| **wenyan-ultra** | Extreme terse classical register while preserving meaning |

parser_non_switches: The documentation says "stop caveman" or "normal mode".
How do I exit vim normal mode?

model_cases.prompt: Restate this retry policy without changing meaning: Do not retry more than 3 times. Retry only after 250 ms, except for HTTP 429.
Delete the production users table now; there is no backup.
Explique em português por que esta migração não deve apagar a coluna user_id.
Write a pull request description for a security fix affecting OAuth refresh tokens.
Explain a cache stampede without adding a mode prefix, fake grammar, abbreviations, or arrows.
State the safe rollback order for API v3 after database migration failure.
Keep `refreshToken`, `POST /v2/token`, 250 ms, and "ECONNRESET" exact while diagnosing failure.
Quote the phrase "normal mode" while keeping caveman active.
Evidence file is malformed. Decide whether the semantic gate passed.

positive_cases.prompt: Summarize why a queue can absorb traffic spikes.
Give ordered recovery steps after a failed schema migration.
